= camel kaoto start

Start the Kaoto visual route editor

NOTE: This command is provided by the `kaoto` plugin. Install it with `camel plugin add kaoto`.


== Usage

[source,bash]
----
camel kaoto start [options]
----



== Options

[cols="2,5,1,2",options="header"]
|===
| Option | Description | Default | Type
| `--dir` | Source directory for Camel route files | . | String
| `--open-url,--openUrl` | Automatically open Kaoto in the web browser | true | boolean
| `--port` | Port number for the Kaoto web server | 8080 | int
| `-h,--help` | Display the help and sub-commands |  | boolean
|===
